text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the race unfolds, a certain
Umamusume
watches intently...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Would you look at this! A flurry of
cherry
blossoms has taken the track by
storm as we
come down the final stretch
of the autumn Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Her form is incredible! She's even better
than she
was at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is in the lead, and
she's not
letting anyone take it from her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So this is my rival...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O tears past the finish
line and
takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
N-no way! Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap
lost?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She stole that win outta nowhere! She
must be
thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I'm still... not good enough!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stop at this! A single victory
isn't
enough. I need to win more and
more and more
and more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I want to light a fire in her heart, then I
have to
go much, much further than this!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Eep?! Wh-what was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes! She has that look in her eyes
again!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What incredible intensity, Chiyo. I can
feel it
running throughout my body.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your fangs are bared and your gaze
pinned on a
single target. When you
stare at me with those
eyes like a
starving wolf...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I can barely think straight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking some time to wipe off her
sweat,
Sakura Chiyono O finally speaks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I swore that I would spark
Maruzen's
engine to life and revive her
drive.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why this victory today isn't
enough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's strength is extraordinary in
every sense
of the word... so I can't
afford to stay within
conventional limits
either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Breaking out of those limits is the
absolute
minimum if I want her to
recognize me as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well... I have an idea.
choice_data_list: Then which race should we run next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Sakura Chiyono O asks
Maruzensky
to meet her on the roof.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on winning the autumn Tenno
Sho,
Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you. So you were watching
me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep winning as many times
as it
takes until the fire in your heart is
reignited.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you say I'm still not enough, then I'll
intensify
my training even more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you say you need time to think, then
I'll wait
until you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running until I reach your heart,
and you
see me as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And to back up those words, I have a
proposal to
make.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there's a certain race I
want to run
with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a G1 turf race in Tokyo that
measures a
classic distance of 2,400
meters. It fits all the
criteria of your
dream race—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about the autumn festival
where the
best of the best from around
the world
compete—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, I know that I don't have the
skill it
takes to compete against you yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So when next year comes, and it's time
for the
Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please race me there with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wind blows past them, and though
it's only a
moment, it feels so much
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Throughout their conversation, the sun
has been
slowly sinking lower toward the
horizon, and it
glints...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How blindingly bright... I can't pretend
not to see,
can I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My peak has already passed, and unlike
the sun in
the sky, I doubt I will ever be
able to reach my
zenith again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A breath of time passes, then
Maruzensky tears
the envelope she's
been holding into pieces.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll still wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with those words, their promise with
each
other takes on a new form.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're the only one who would
praise me
for something like that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for deciding our next goal without

discussing it with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: I don't mind. After all, it's your path.
I don't mind. After all, it's your path.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Though as your Trainer, I'll still be cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heh.... Haha! Trainer, you're really too
much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, I'm glad I have you in my
corner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've only got a year to prep, so
let's get
started.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger, and I want to
kindle
Maruzen's passion for running
too. What G1 race
do you think I should
tackle next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stare into her expectant eyes and think.
If her
plan is to come to fruition, we
have two options.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mile race would be good training to
match the
Hot Rod's speed, which would
point us to the
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Alternatively, we could hone Chiyono
O's racing
instincts against stronger
opponents in the
medium-distance
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I think our best choice is to
go with...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Yasuda Kinen.
choice_data_list: The "Yasuda Kinen" on the mile route
The 'Takarazuka Kinen' of the medium-distance route.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let me pencil that down in my
Chiyonotes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to compete in the
Yasuda
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Goal Race is now the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let me pencil that down in my
Chiyonotes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to compete in the

Takarazuka Kinen.
